text: Delroy and Chantal's 10th anniversary is 14 May. Remind me to book somewhere the day before, they love that Caribbean place on Mill Rd. Chantal can't do anything too spicy since her reflux started, so check the menu has milder stuff. Delroy mentioned he'd like to go back to Jamaica for the 15th.
Bogdan is vegan now, properly, not just weekdays. Don't do the lamb when he comes over.
chidi engaged!! proposed in lisbon over the weekend, efua said yes obvs. wedding prob next summer
Aarav doesn't drink at all. Get some of that alcohol free ginger beer in for Saturday.

okay so Ioana's sister Marta is getting married on the 3rd of June in Cluj and Ioana is maid of honour and she's really nervous about the speech um I should message her that morning to wish her luck and maybe call her the next day to hear how it all went
Santiago coeliac - remember for the bbq on 22/06

Deepa allergic to tree nuts, not peanuts weirdly. Carries an EpiPen.
Finn asked Esme to marry him on 2nd Feb! Ring was his gran's. Send a congrats card the week after, when they're back from Edinburgh.

Had lunch with Afua. She and her husband Femi are renewing their vows on 9 August, 25 years. She wants it small, just family, at the church where they married, then food at theirs afterwards. Femi is doing jollof for 40 people apparently. Afua mentioned she'd love a proper photo album of the day since they barely have any photos from the first wedding. Could be a nice group present, ask Yuki if she'd chip in.
Yuki only drinks oolong or barley tea, never coffee. Not into anything too sweet either.
Yusuf's wedding 18/09. Stag do the weekend before in Dublin. I'm not going on the stag but I'm doing a reading at the ceremony.
Bruno - pescatarian, loves a negroni, hates coriander
Siobhan's engagement party Sat 12th Oct, her fiancé Oisín's family coming over from Galway for it. Remind me to pick up flowers that morning.

Tomás had his hip op on the 4th. Ring him a few days after to see how he's getting on. His wife Lena says he's grumpy about the hospital food lol. She's been back and forth every day and sounds exhausted, kids are off school too. Maybe drop a lasagne round for them at the weekend, no mushrooms, Lena hates them.
shira lactose intolerant, oisin veggie, jorge eats anything. for the dinner on 1 nov
Milan said his partner Ellie's birthday is 30th March and she's obsessed with matcha everything. Taking notes.
Zainab got married on 7 July, honeymoon in Zanzibar till the 21st. Ask how it was once she's back.

note to self Delroy said his mum's diabetic now so when we have them over for Sunday lunch no proper dessert or find something sugar free uh and he's a bit stressed about it all to be honest so maybe don't make a big thing of it
Carlos and his wife Marta's first anniversary - 15/04. He's planning a surprise paella night at home. Must text him the day after to ask how it went.
Efua off gluten for a month, trying it for her skin.
Venue confirmed for my birthday dinner, 6 Dec at Rosa's. Booked for 10.
Rang Chantal. Her daughter just got engaged to a lad called Femi Reyes from work. Wedding not till 2028 they reckon.
Bogdan's wife Ioana is due in March!! He told me over pints. Not telling anyone yet apparently.
Aarav and Deepa wedding anniversary 21st of November. Last year he forgot lol. Text Aarav the day before so he doesn't do it again.
Ellie on keto. Also off booze til Christmas. So maybe not the wine tasting thing with her.
Salma's dad passed away on Tuesday. Funeral 28/10, I'm going with Esme. Send flowers to her mum's the day before.
liam says no fizzy drinks for his boy, sugar thing. kid's 6. party sat

Finn wedding planning update - venue booked for 14 June 2027, Esme wants a food truck instead of a sit down meal, Finn's dad not happy about it. Esme's mum is gluten free and Finn's brother Sam has a severe shellfish allergy so definitely no seafood truck. Finn v stressed about the budget. Offer to help taste test cakes the week after next.
Chidi made the best suya tonight. Ask for the spice mix.
Yuki and Milan's anniversary dinner on Friday is cancelled, Milan's away for work. They're doing it 12/11 instead I think.
Santiago takes his own mate everywhere, the tea thing with the metal straw. Loves alfajores too.

Jorge and Shira's engagement went public today. Party at theirs on 25 Oct. Bring a bottle of something nice, she likes Rioja, he's strictly a beer man. Shira's sister Zainab is flying in from Manchester for it, haven't seen her since uni. Apparently they're thinking a spring wedding, April or May, somewhere in Andalucia.
Mrs Moreau next door turned 80 on Sunday and I missed it. Pop round with a card tomorrow.
Lena's nervous about meeting Tomás's parents at their anniversary do on 2nd Nov. His mum's very traditional apparently. Text her that evening to see how it went.
Uncle Yusuf - halal only, no exceptions. Doesn't like spicy food either, which surprised me.

right so just off the phone with Zainab she and Bruno have set a date it's the 20th of May next year in Marrakech and she wants me to help with the menu tasting which is sometime in February she said Bruno's family are mostly vegetarian so they need a really good veggie main and she's a bit overwhelmed honestly I should call her the week after the tasting to see how she's doing

Need to sort the MOT before the 14th and renew the parking permit.

nothing much today, quiet one. finished the book.

Don't forget to message Efua the day before to confirm numbers. Also Chidi's cousin Yusuf has a nut allergy, so the tiramisu can't have amaretto or anything like that. Chidi's taking her to Ghana over Christmas to meet the rest of the family.

Yusuf and his wife's anniversary is the 5th of Sept. They always go to the same Lebanese place. Book it for them as a surprise? Ask her sister first.
Ellie's cat Miso had a tooth out yesterday. She was in bits. Check on her tomorrow evening.
Delroy's birthday drinks were last night - he only drinks rum and coke, noted for next time. Ask Bruno if he got home ok.

She used to run a bakery so maybe a nice tin of shortbread too, she's got a sweet tooth. Party at the care home on the 20th, Oisín's flying over for it.
